# steadycron_tag (Resource)

Manages a SteadyCron tag (`key=value` pair with an optional color). Tags are account-scoped — the same tag is shared across all jobs that reference it. Reference a tag's `id` in `steadycron_http_job.tags` or `steadycron_heartbeat_monitor.tags`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "steadycron_tag" "env_prod" {
  key   = "env"
  value = "prod"
  color = "green"
}

resource "steadycron_tag" "env_staging" {
  key   = "env"
  value = "staging"
  color = "yellow"
}

resource "steadycron_tag" "team_platform" {
  key   = "team"
  value = "platform"
}

# Attach tags to a job via the job's `tags` attribute
resource "steadycron_http_job" "example" {
  name   = "example-job"
  method = "GET"
  url    = "https://example.com"

  interval_seconds = 3600

  tags = [
    steadycron_tag.env_prod.id,
    steadycron_tag.team_platform.id,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Tag key (e.g. `env`). Allowed characters: `[a-z0-9_-]`, max 32 characters.
- `value` (String) Tag value (e.g. `prod`). Allowed characters: `[a-z0-9_-]`, max 64 characters.

### Optional

- `color` (String) Named hue token from the SteadyCron design palette (e.g. `green`, `blue`). When empty the server auto-derives a color.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID.
